title: 共享工作空间中的人机协作协同效应研究
summary: 研究共享工作空间的人机团队协作，发现添加协作者可能因缺乏协调结构而降低性能。提出结合共享群组记忆与模拟人在环门的脚手架方法，在三人团队中显著提升性能，强调协调与专业整合的重要性。
summary_en: Studies human-AI collaboration in shared workspaces, finding that adding collaborators can lower performance without coordination structure. Proposes scaffolding with shared memory and human-in-the-loop gates, improving performance especially in three-person teams, highlighting the importance of coordination and expertise integration.
